actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates an Archeotoad by croaking multiple times as if you were making a song affecting all those within 30 ft
description.value: The caster emulates an Archeotoad by croaking multiple times as if you were making a song affecting all those within 30 ft. The targets of this spell receives the Frog status effect if they fail their save. The victim is polymorphed into a frog temporarily, unable to cast spells or attack, but can defend itself. Learned From archeotoad
